examples.description: Everything needed to give the client an issued invoice
The same with a payment reminder in Bahasa Melayu

_meta.generated_from: sales-invoice-handoff.ts simplerSalesHandoffPrepare (sales-message-prepare.ts words, sales-share-links.ts link get, sales-pdf-mcp.ts owner PDF lane)

description: Get one issued invoice ready to give the client, in one call: the document, the client link (made if it has none), the PDF (printed or the stored one) and the prepared message (invoice_message_prepare's words, with the link). ready lists the parts made; missing gives each other part's reason_code, reason and next_call. A turned-off link is never re-issued: invoice_share action 'rotate' waits for the owner's approval. NOTHING IS SENT. Refusals (CONFLICT): draft SIMPLER_SALES_MESSAGE_NOT_ISSUED (issue it with invoice_update status 'sent'); cancelled; written off; SIMPLER_SALES_MESSAGE_PURPOSE_UNFIT (send its next_call). Read-only token or viewer: FORBIDDEN. Free.

id.description: The invoice's id, from invoice_list or invoice_read.

language.description: The message's language: 'en', 'ms' or 'zh'. Leave out to use the client's message_language (English when none is set).

purpose.description: The message's purpose: 'invoice', 'reminder', 'receipt' or 'promise_follow_up' (a promised payment date has passed). Leave out to get the one that fits the invoice's state.
